capabilities.summary: Seeded procedural stereo patterns for 14 hip-hop and adjacent profiles.
Bounded RIFF PCM16 stereo output with peak/RMS metadata.
Bounded PCM16 mono/stereo import, four-slice beat placement and semitone resampling.
Qt 6 Widgets application source and CMake target are present; desktop compile is CI-gated because the local build environment has no Qt 6 SDK.
Variation index and seed deterministically initialize the PRNG.
Exports versioned ventusample.pack.v1 manifests and WAV assets that Reaper validates and compares read-only; the Reaper consumer reads manifest metadata only and leaves WAV files untouched.
QMR-20 render cohesion plus Billionaire Golden Era crate reassembly, weighted drum voicing, shared swing timing, deterministic turnarounds and stereo-linked mastering.
Editable golden-era Boom Bap profile with deterministic 0-2-1-3 imported-crate reassembly, weighted kick/snare voicing, restrained hats and deterministic rendering.
Exports readable key/mode labels in tonal WAV filenames and per-file v2 manifest metadata; unpitched drum assets remain unlabelled.
Seeded weighted offline DSP routing with configurable effect pool, serial/parallel graphs, bar/onset triggers, bounded feedback/wet, RMS matching and sample-peak guarding.

safety_boundaries: Offline rendering by default; no network telemetry or background audio capture.
Imported WAV files are untrusted input and are size, chunk, format and frame bounded.
No external native library is loaded implicitly.
No driver, firmware, system-audio or hardware control is performed.
Real-time playback, DAW plugin hosting, tempo-preserving time-stretch and GPU dispatch are not implemented.
extension_points: Explicit opt-in Pytyliki C ABI measurements after differential tests.
Additional independent style profiles and DSP kernels behind validated parameters.
Additional phrase strategies can extend the shared 16-step groove schedule without changing the pack v1 contract.
